description: Violations of architecture/modules.json that cannot be fixed yet. Each entry names the rule, the importing files, how many occurrences are allowed, and the migration step that removes them. pnpm arch:check fails on any violation beyond these and on any entry that allows more than remains, so the list only shrinks.

exceptions.reason: The Controller session code still calls the command and process modules (cli output, executables, daemon runner, tunnel) that belong to its process shell; M10 splits session-core from process/ so the dependency runs one way.
State files are written through the platform helper directly; M10 puts them behind the StateStore port.
previews.ts opens the Node tunnel registry itself; M10 moves it behind the Controller process composition.
The resource stores write files through the platform helper; they move behind the same StateStore port as the Controller state.
Provider registration, discovery and the provider commands each import their concrete provider; M10 leaves one providers.ts composition root.
The update commands read Controller releases through the helper in relay-core; M10 moves release lookup to a module both sides import.
The journal draws its epoch with crypto.randomUUID; the Relay's Ids port arrives with BrokerState in M11, and the journal then receives its epochs from it.
broker.ts is the whole Relay in one closure; M11 extracts the concerns and leaves relay.ts under 900 lines.
host.ts holds createAgentHostRuntime; M10 extracts session-core and the publisher.
App.tsx holds the Workbench state; M13 moves it to state/ and hooks/.
Controller tests wire the Relay, providers and the Workbench by file path. The wiring moves into the seam suites of agent-remote-seams and provider ./testing entries as M10 extracts session-core.
